payload.posture: Read 2 Samuel 1:1–16 as one movement in Saul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a messenger reports defeat, tells David that he killed Saul, presents crown and bracelet, and dies under the weight of his own testimony. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Saul's story.
